title: 中国云增速：低基数下有望超全球，未来20年科技主线换了吗？
speaker: Eleanor Leung

segments.en: In some of these internet firms that you talk about, the hyper-scale, they are very cheap in terms of valuation.
segments.zh: 你提到的这些互联网公司中，超大规模企业估值非常便宜。

segments.en: I think Baba is trading at like 10 times. You still have some of these hardware names like SMYC that's trading 80 times.
segments.zh: 比如阿里交易在10倍左右，而一些硬件公司如SMYC交易在80倍。

segments.en: Do you think that valuation makes sense to you when it comes to what you're seeing, when it comes to the hyper-scale versus the hardware side?
segments.zh: 从超大规模与硬件端的对比看，你觉得这样的估值合理吗？

segments.en: I think China may deserve a discount because the economy is really, really weak.
segments.zh: 我认为中国市场可能应享有折价，因为经济确实非常疲软。

segments.en: Overall consumption, people say sea that retail sales was down 3% in October.
segments.zh: 整体消费方面，有人说10月零售销售下降了3%。

segments.en: So I think that will be overhang on the China market. However, the biggest difference in the valuation, we don't see that, is justified.
segments.zh: 所以这会对内地市场构成压力。然而，估值上的最大差异我们并不认为合理。

segments.en: Because China cloud revenue growth will likely outgrow the global because we're from a low base.
segments.zh: 因为中国云收入增长可能超过全球，由于基数较低。

segments.en: And also for the next 20 years, China is going to put in all the effort behind AI, behind building a tech industry.
segments.zh: 而且未来20年，中国将全力投入AI和科技产业建设。

segments.en: So last 20 years, you are buying consumption related stock in China for the next 20 years, you're buying the tech stock in China.
segments.zh: 过去20年买中国消费类权益资产，未来20年买中国科技类权益资产。

segments.en: And China cloud will not grow slower compared to the overseas.
segments.zh: 中国云增长不会比海外慢。

segments.en: And now we have a tighter chip supply, which is fair.
segments.zh: 现在芯片供应更紧张了，这合理。

segments.en: But when the domestic chip pick up in terms of supply, we can grow as fast as the overseas.
segments.zh: 但一旦国内芯片供应跟上，我们就能和海外一样快增长。

segments.en: Is there one company that you see that has a better AI monetization path?
segments.zh: 有没有一家公司，你认为其AI变现路径更优？
